Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:4306
Court No. - 12

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 371 of 2024
Applicant :- Arjun
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.
The Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Home, Lko.

And Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Sheikh Mohammad Ali

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Supplementary Affidavit filed in Court is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
No one appears for the informant despite notice.
3. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.242 of 2023 under section 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act and section 3(2)(v) SC/ST Act, P.S. Ikauna, District Shravasti.
Arjun vs State Of U.P. Thru.

4. Initially a missing person report was lodged.

Subsequently, in the statements under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she had gone out of her own free will and physical relations were also formed.
In the radio-logical report, the age of the victim is, prima-facie, assessed at 19 years.
The applicant has no criminal history.
5. Considering the statement under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., and the radiological age coupled with the fact that the applicant is in jail since 30.09.2023, a case for bail is made out.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Arjun be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.25000/- (Twenty Five Thousand)
each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.1.2024 VNP/-
 
Arjun vs State Of U.P. Thru.
